english.note: Use this for the gain or loss produced by an investment, as in 投資回報.
Use 回報 for money gained as a return on an investment.

examples.english: The return on this investment is pretty good.
examples.jyutping: ni1 hong6 tau4 zi1 ge3 wui4 bou3 m4 co3

examples.english: The earnings from this investment are pretty good.
examples.jyutping: ni1 hong6 tau4 zi1 ge3 wui4 bou3 m4 co3
